components.necessaryInvariant: Current Station Zero state and retained Game evidence can be committed in the same local SQLite transaction; content-addressed artifacts/journal chains fail closed on tamper and response-loss recovery does not mint duplicate Game effects.
components.notAuthority: Persistence does not mint Game, Host, Human, rights, Artifact, or release semantics.
components.deletionWake: Delete/move when an owner-external evidence substrate preserves the same-transaction invariant losslessly. FULL_EXTERNAL_SUBSTITUTION remains NOT_ADMITTED.

components.necessaryInvariant: Game/domain consumers depend on a bounded Game evidence capability rather than importing persistence or Host internals as semantic authority.
components.notAuthority: The current LocalEvidenceAdapter is replaceable implementation; the port is an ownership seam, not a second Host.
components.deletionWake: The adapter may disappear when another implementation satisfies the port and atomicity contract; the semantic seam may be further thinned if consumers remain owner-isolated.

components.necessaryInvariant: Team Effect/Dispatch/Observation standing is derived from TeamRound/TeamTickPlan plus authoritative Game command receipt/World Event; missing or identity-divergent authoritative evidence must make completion fail closed.
components.notAuthority: The view reconstructs Game commitment semantics and does not persist a duplicate generic Host lifecycle.
components.deletionWake: Delete/derive differently only if the same Game-specific commitment invariants remain mechanically testable without a duplicate lifecycle.

conclusion: No residual component is justified merely by historical presence. One component is explicit compatibility debt, one is a thin ownership seam, and one is a derived Game-semantic view. Their retention is bounded by deletion-sensitive invariants rather than LOC minimization.
